'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta Jon Benkert Holtet LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jon Benkert Holtet]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jon Benkert Holtet]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-europeans-reset-beta-event-6th-place-ls-jon-holtet-wys/ PC list]
